category_title: Adolescents with a history of school failure and mistrust of formal education
scenario_title: Apathy and lack of motivation towards assigned tasks
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete a reading and writing worksheet during a flexible study period in the Social Guarantee Programme.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read this text and write down your answers to the questions on the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Man, why do we gotta do this? I do not like studying.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is the assignment for today. Just give it a try and see how far you get.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't even get what these words mean. I do not think I am clever enough for this anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying. Just write down whatever you think is the right answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet away) Nah, I'm not doing it. It was easy, but I was not interested in it. I'm not wasting my time on stuff that isn't useful to me.

context.time_context: Timetables are flexible, different subjects are not taught at fixed times

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When presented with tasks that are not useful to them
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Lack of motivation and general apathy, usually did not complete the tasks set by the teacher, show little constancy in studying
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: they are only motivated by what is useful to them, Their interests are very short term
related_quotes: It was easy, but I was not interested in it.

behavior_patterns.condition: When facing learning difficulties (especially in basic aspects of the instrumental areas)
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Lack of academic working habits, language is inexact and lacks precision, heavily dependent on slang
related_quotes: I do not think I am clever enough.
